tagline.en: Traditional wisdom. A clearer way forward.

metaDescription.en: A preview of our astrology centre. Explore traditional astrology, Vastu and puja services. Offerings await client approval.
metaDescription.kn: ನಮ್ಮ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರದ ಮುನ್ನೋಟ. ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯ, ವಾಸ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಪೂಜಾ ಸೇವೆಗಳು ಅನುಮೋದನೆಗೆ ಒಳಪಟ್ಟಿವೆ.

heading.en: Traditional wisdom. A clearer way forward.

text.en: Explore the traditions of Jyotisha, Vastu and sacred rituals — a thoughtful place to begin with the questions that matter to you.
text.kn: ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯ, ವಾಸ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಪವಿತ್ರ ಆಚರಣೆಗಳ ಪರಂಪರೆಯನ್ನು ಅನ್ವೇಷಿಸಿ — ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಆರಂಭಿಸಲು ಒಂದು ನೆಲೆ.

heading.en: Rooted in tradition. Open to your questions.

text.en: Welcome to Shri Lakshmi Venkateshwara Astro Center. This preview introduces a considered space for traditional astrology and spiritual practices. Details about the practitioner and the centre will be shared once confirmed.
text.kn: Shri Lakshmi Venkateshwara Astro Center ಗೆ ಸ್ವಾಗತ. ಈ ಮುನ್ನೋಟವು ಪಾರಂಪರಿಕ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಆಚರಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕೇಂದ್ರದ ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ದೃಢೀಕರಣದ ನಂತರ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

text.en: Bring the topics you would like to discuss to your consultation.
text.kn: ನೀವು ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲು ಬಯಸುವ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆಗೆ ತನ್ನಿ.

text.en: Explore Jyotisha, Vastu and traditional practices at your own pace.
text.kn: ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯ, ವಾಸ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಪಾರಂಪರಿಕ ಆಚರಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಅನ್ವೇಷಿಸಿ.

text.en: Ask questions and take time to understand the guidance offered.
text.kn: ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಸಮಯ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

answer.en: You can share the questions you would like to discuss. The format and availability can be confirmed when you make an enquiry.
answer.kn: ನೀವು ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲು ಬಯಸುವ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು. ವಿಚಾರಣೆಯ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಧಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಲಭ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ದೃಢೀಕರಿಸಬಹುದು.

question.en: Can I ask about more than one topic?

answer.en: Yes. When enquiring, mention the areas you want to discuss so the appropriate consultation can be arranged.
answer.kn: ಹೌದು. ವಿಚಾರಿಸುವಾಗ ನೀವು ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲು ಬಯಸುವ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಿ.

question.en: Do I need an exact birth time?

answer.en: An accurate birth time can help with preparing a birth chart. If you are unsure, mention that when making your enquiry.
answer.kn: ಜನ್ಮ ಕುಂಡಲಿಯನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸಲು ನಿಖರವಾದ ಜನ್ಮ ಸಮಯ ಸಹಾಯಕವಾಗಬಹುದು. ತಿಳಿದಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ವಿಚಾರಿಸುವಾಗ ತಿಳಿಸಿ.

answer.en: Please ask about current consultation options and availability when you contact the centre.
answer.kn: ಕೇಂದ್ರವನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿದಾಗ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ವಿಧಾನಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಲಭ್ಯತೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕೇಳಿ.

question.en: How can I arrange a consultation?

answer.en: Booking and contact details are being confirmed. Please visit the Contact page for availability updates.
answer.kn: ಬುಕಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ದೃಢೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆ. ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಾಗಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ.

answer.en: The services and pujas shown here are provisional. The centre will confirm its offerings, fees and consultation formats before launch.
answer.kn: ಇಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಸೇವೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪೂಜೆಗಳು ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿವೆ. ಕೇಂದ್ರವು ಸೇವೆಗಳು, ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಲೋಚನಾ ವಿಧಾನಗಳನ್ನು ದೃಢೀಕರಿಸಲಿದೆ.

answer.en: Birth chart readings typically use the date, time and place of birth. Please wait for confirmed booking instructions before sharing personal details.
answer.kn: ಜನ್ಮ ಕುಂಡಲಿಗೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಜನ್ಮ ದಿನಾಂಕ, ಸಮಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಳ ಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಮೊದಲು ದೃಢೀಕೃತ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ.

intro.en: Introducing Shri Lakshmi Venkateshwara Astro Center.

shortDescription.en: A complete reading of your birth chart: strengths, timing and the road ahead.
shortDescription.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜನ್ಮ ಕುಂಡಲಿಯ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ: ಶಕ್ತಿ, ಕಾಲ ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂದಿನ ದಾರಿ.

children.text: Your kundli is a map of the sky at the moment you were born. Read carefully, it shows the themes that run through your life: temperament, relationships, work, health and the periods when each comes into focus.
What the reading covers
Lagna, Moon sign and planetary strengths
Current and upcoming Mahadasha and Antardasha
Career, finances, marriage and family
Practical remedies where they are genuinely useful

en.text: Bring your exact time of birth if you have it. Even a 15-minute difference can change the Lagna.

whySeek.en: A second opinion on a chart

question.en: What if I do not know my exact birth time?

answer.en: The practitioner can rectify the birth time using key life events such as marriage, the birth of children or changes of job.
answer.kn: ವಿವಾಹ, ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಜನನ, ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯಂತಹ ಘಟನೆಗಳಿಂದ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿಗಳು ಜನ್ಮ ಸಮಯವನ್ನು ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಬಹುದು.

answer.en: Usually 45 to 60 minutes, with time for your questions.
answer.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ೪೫ ರಿಂದ ೬೦ ನಿಮಿಷ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೂ ಸಮಯವಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

shortDescription.en: Guna milan and a deeper compatibility reading for couples and families.
shortDescription.kn: ಗುಣ ಮಿಲನ ಮತ್ತು ದಂಪತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ.

children.text: A guna score is only the starting point. The practitioner also looks at the 7th house, Venus and Jupiter, Mangal dosha in both charts and the dasha periods each partner is entering, so the family gets a complete picture.
When to consult
Before fixing an alliance
When marriage is being delayed
Choosing a muhurta for the wedding

answer.en: It is the traditional minimum, but planetary compatibility matters as much as the score. The practitioner explains both.
answer.kn: ಅದು ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ, ಆದರೆ ಗ್ರಹ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಯೂ ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಮುಖ್ಯ. ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿಗಳು ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

children.text: Most Vastu imbalances can be corrected with changes to how rooms are used, where heavy furniture sits and simple placements. Site visits and remote review options are provisional and await confirmation.

en.text: Have a floor plan ready, with north marked, before the visit.

answer.en: Yes. Send the floor plan with north marked and the practitioner will review it on a video call.

children.text: Doshas are often described in frightening terms. In reality many are mild or cancelled by other factors in the chart. The practitioner first confirms whether a dosha is actually present and how strong it is, and only then suggests remedies such as japa, a specific puja or charity.

title.en: A beginner’s guide to Vedic astrology

excerpt.en: A gentle introduction to birth charts, planetary periods and preparing for a consultation.

children.text: Vedic astrology, or Jyotisha, is a tradition of interpreting the positions of celestial bodies in relation to a person’s birth. A consultation can be a chance to reflect on questions about work, relationships or personal goals.
Start with the birth chart

A birth chart, also called a kundli, is prepared from the date, time and place of birth. Practitioners consider signs, houses and planetary placements together rather than relying on one feature alone.
What are planetary periods?
Dasha systems divide life into periods associated with different planets. An astrologer may discuss these periods alongside the birth chart when considering a question.
Preparing for a reading
Bring the most accurate birth details available and a few questions you would like to explore. Ask for explanations in plain language and take time to consider any suggestions.

en.heading: Have a question about your birth chart?

title.en: Gemstone guidance: questions to ask first

excerpt.en: A practical guide to discussing gemstones, costs and alternatives before making a decision.

children.text: In some Jyotisha traditions, gemstones are associated with planets and may be discussed as a personal practice. Recommendations vary, so it helps to understand the reasoning before making a purchase.
Ask how the recommendation was made
A practitioner may consider the whole birth chart and your question. Ask which tradition they use and why a particular stone is being suggested.
Consider your budget
Ask about the full cost, the seller’s return policy and any independent certification. You can take time to compare options and decline a purchase.
Discuss alternatives
If a stone does not feel right for you, ask whether there are other traditional practices to consider. A consultation should leave room for your own preferences.

title.en: Understanding the 12 houses in your kundli

excerpt.en: Each house in a birth chart speaks to one area of life. Here is a plain-language guide to what each one means.
excerpt.kn: ಜನ್ಮ ಕುಂಡಲಿಯ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಭಾವವೂ ಜೀವನದ ಒಂದು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದರ ಅರ್ಥಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಳ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ.

children.text: A kundli is divided into twelve houses, or bhavas. Each one governs a different part of life, and the planets sitting in them, along with the signs they fall in, colour how that part of life unfolds.
The houses of self: 1st, 5th and 9th
The 1st house (Lagna) is you: body, temperament and how you meet the world. The 5th covers children, creativity and intelligence, and the 9th covers dharma, teachers and fortune.
The houses of wealth: 2nd, 6th and 10th
The 2nd house shows family and accumulated wealth, the 6th daily work, health and competition, and the 10th career and public standing.

en.text: No single house tells the whole story. A good reading always looks at the house, its lord, and the planets aspecting it together.

children.text: The houses of relationships: 3rd, 7th and 11th
The 3rd governs siblings and courage, the 7th marriage and partnerships, and the 11th friends, networks and gains.
The houses of liberation: 4th, 8th and 12th
The 4th is home and mother, the 8th transformation and longevity, and the 12th expenses, foreign lands and spiritual release.

en.heading: Want to know what your houses say?

children.text: ಕುಂಡಲಿಯನ್ನು ಹನ್ನೆರಡು ಭಾವಗಳಾಗಿ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಭಾವವೂ ಜೀವನದ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಆಳುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಅದರಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಗ್ರಹಗಳು ಆ ಭಾಗ ಹೇಗೆ ತೆರೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.
ಸ್ವಭಾವದ ಭಾವಗಳು: ೧, ೫ ಮತ್ತು ೯
ಮೊದಲ ಭಾವ (ಲಗ್ನ) ನೀವೇ: ದೇಹ, ಸ್ವಭಾವ ಮತ್ತು ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುವ ರೀತಿ. ಐದನೇ ಭಾವ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬುದ್ಧಿ, ಒಂಬತ್ತನೇ ಭಾವ ಧರ್ಮ, ಗುರು ಮತ್ತು ಭಾಗ್ಯ.
ಸಂಪತ್ತಿನ ಭಾವಗಳು: ೨, ೬ ಮತ್ತು ೧೦
ಎರಡನೇ ಭಾವ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಮತ್ತು ಧನ, ಆರನೇ ಭಾವ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಕೆಲಸ ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ, ಹತ್ತನೇ ಭಾವ ವೃತ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಾನಮಾನ.

kn.text: ಯಾವುದೇ ಒಂದು ಭಾವ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಭಾವ, ಅದರ ಅಧಿಪತಿ ಮತ್ತು ದೃಷ್ಟಿ ಬೀರುವ ಗ್ರಹಗಳನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ನೋಡಬೇಕು.

title.en: Mangal dosha before marriage: what it really means

excerpt.en: Mangal dosha is one of the most feared terms in matchmaking, and one of the most misunderstood. A calm look at the facts.

children.text: Mangal dosha (also called Kuja dosha) is said to be present when Mars occupies the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th house. By that definition, nearly half of all charts would have it, which is a sign that the rule is not meant to be applied mechanically.
When the dosha is cancelled
Mars in its own sign or exalted
Both partners having comparable Mangal dosha
Strong Jupiter aspecting Mars or the 7th house

en.text: Never cancel an alliance on the word "Mangal dosha" alone. Ask for the full chart comparison.

title.en: Seven Vastu tips for a peaceful home

excerpt.en: Small changes to light, layout and clutter that make a real difference, no renovation needed.

children.text: Vastu is ultimately about light, air and the flow of daily life. These simple adjustments are worth trying before anything structural.
1. Keep the north-east open and clean
This is the most sacred corner of the home. Avoid heavy storage, toilets or clutter here.
2. Sleep with your head to the south
Traditional texts recommend south or east. Avoid north.
3. Let morning light into the east
Open east-facing windows in the morning and keep them uncovered by heavy curtains.

title.en: What is Sade Sati, and should you worry?

excerpt.en: Saturn's seven-and-a-half-year transit has a fearsome reputation. Here is what it actually does, and how to move through it well.

children.text: Sade Sati is the period when Saturn transits the sign before your Moon sign, your Moon sign itself, and the sign after it. Each phase lasts about two and a half years.
Saturn is a teacher. Sade Sati often brings responsibility, hard work and a clearing-out of what is not working. For many people it is also a time of real, lasting achievement.
